scope: Read-only comparison of fixed Arc and context-history sources; no application import, execution, HTTP, PostgreSQL, browser or product writes.

arc.meaning: currentGroups contains all workspace panes; visibleGroups contains active workspace panes. Hidden composers deliberately remain mounted with visible=false to preserve local state.

context.meaning: currentGroups represents the currently displayed groups on this base. historyAuthorized checks activeId within these groups.

finding.hazard: A textual merge retaining currentGroups for historyAuthorized would broaden that guard to hidden workspaces. Additional binding visible/host guards exist, so this is not evidence of an actual leak in either fixed source.
finding.requiredComposition: Use active workspace visibility semantics (Arc visibleGroups or equivalent) for history authorization. Preserve currentGroups all-workspace semantics for total capacity and ownership; do not globally rename it to the visible-only list.
finding.sessionPreservation: Keep Arc AppActions.layout, captured layout invocation, open/close/change commands and pane/conversation validity. Add context binding subscriptions, sync in updateActions and releaseView/dispose cleanup without replacing the Arc session blob.

futureCombinationAcceptance.case: Hold a real decoded context-history response in workspace A, switch to workspace B while A remains mounted.
assert: A context reading becomes unavailable/clears cached detail
A in-flight read is aborted or its late completion suppressed
Center task execution is not cancelled

futureCombinationAcceptance.case: Return to A after releasing the held response.
assert: Only explicit Context reopening fetches again
Draft text, view identity, attachment and recovery receipt ownership remain preserved

futureCombinationAcceptance.case: Move active conversation between panes, then merge/split with an open context surface.
assert: Same viewKey does not create duplicate history readers or lose draft
Authorization follows the current visible pane
At most one history body flight per binding; detail still requires explicit selection

futureCombinationAcceptance.case: Release view or session while a read is held.
assert: No late publication into another conversation or connection

status.currentContextMountedPreparation: Separate single-branch preparation; not combined Arc evidence

workflow: D01 records in existing integration TODO and dashboard drilldown; original authorized integrator performs future exact-scope composition. W01 informed; current two-test-leaf preparation must not mutate frozen Arc or product leaves.
